column2: Princess Celestia has funded an expedition into the northwestern wilderness and encouraged it to expand the bounds of pony knowledge. We have received a letter from the expedition's leader, Acorn Cap.

In the course of our expedition into the northwestern wilderness, we came upon these curious beings for the first time: an intelligent race able to change its own form. We offered gifts to show we meant no harm, and they repaid us with silk of remarkable quality. On the whole, the contact was friendly. I have ordered the expedition to make camp nearby and to venture no further into the lands of other races, lest we give offence to our hosts. I have now sent a letter to Canterlot, asking that Her Highness's government provide the funds and supplies for a fort to be raised here, so that later explorers and merchants may be provisioned. - From the diary of Acorn Cap
